//==
// # Rigid-body dynamics interfaces
//
// The interface an environmental force model implements: given a body in its
// current state, evaluate the world-space force in newtons acting on it.

// A model of an environmental force acting on planar bodies. ForceOn
// evaluates the world-space force, in newtons, exerted on the given body in
// its current state.
interface IForceModel2D
{
    ForceOn(x: Self, body: RigidBody2D): Vector2D;
}

// A model of an environmental force acting on spatial bodies. ForceOn
// evaluates the world-space force, in newtons, exerted on the given body in
// its current state.
interface IForceModel3D
{
    ForceOn(x: Self, body: RigidBody3D): Vector3D;
}
